title: Amnesty reveals alarming impact of online abuse against women | Amnesty International
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Bookmarked: Amnesty reveals alarming impact of online abuse against women | Amnesty International

https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2017/11/amnesty-reveals-alarming-impact-of-online-abuse-against-women/

We need to design for diversity and inclusion from the get go. Also why I believe in a more localized rather than a decentralized web. Anonymous hate with untraceable packets doesn't sound like fun to me. Rather empower our local institutions to better protect Internet health.
